facts.fact_content: Singapore's population is projected to be 8,609,518 in 2050.
Singapore's population increased from 8,562,229 in 2049 to 8,609,518 in 2050.
The all-time high population for Singapore is projected to be 8,609,518 in 2050.
The record low population for Singapore was 1,022,100 in 1950.
The average population of Singapore from 1950 to 2050 is 4,063,333.
